Why the late boats pay for themselves

An analysis of the summer trial shows the late sailings covered their crew cost within five weekends, and that the margin came almost entirely from evening return trips by workers in the hospitality trade, according to ticketing records seen by this newspaper.

The records, covering twelve weekends, show a median trip of eleven minutes and a clear peak between midnight and one o'clock, when the Fennel Point bars and kitchens close their doors.

Northwind Press
